page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right, signature at the foot.

main_text.p: nim Domini verbum,ipsa inquam Dei con-cefsio, & sententia, qua pronunciat omnia esse puris pura, fides item recipientis, & gratiarum actio fidelis, facit ut nihil impuritatis habeat cibus Christianorum.

Concidunt ergo hic seinel[?] quęcunq; mer-catores Romani præceperunt de ciborum delectu, de temporum & dierum discrimine. Christiano enim licet quovis tempore vesci cibis, Matth.15. Actor.10. Colos.2. Discimus præterea quanta cum reverentia ad mensam accedere, & ab eadem debeamus recedere. Est enim belluinus vescendi mos, quum homines sine ulla precatione ad mensam se ingerunt (qui mos tamen valde usitatus est in nuptiis, quibus nullus verbi minister inter-est)ac bene saturi, sepulta Dei mentione a-lio se proripiunt: illorumve imitatores fiunt, de quibus scriptum est: Sedit populus ut ederet ac biberet, & surrexerunt ad ludendum. Atqui convivæ Domini sumus, Dominus pascit nos, in hujus oculis versamur, illius munificentia alimur. Precandum ergo & gratias agendas esse ante & post cibum, nemo est qui nō videat, sed &ita in mensa, ut in oculis Dei versandum, quemadmodū piè M. Heinrychus Bullingerus pię memoriæ, monet. Aberit itaq; omnis amaritudo, con-tumelia, calumnia, rixa, obtrectatio, denique luxus & ebrietas, obscœnitas & intemperan-tia omnis: nihil fœdum dictu, aut auditum turpe in mensa proponatur, sed quod honę-[?]

page.notes: Printed word "seinel" (initial letter looks like long s or f) is doubtful; likely a form of "semel". "Colos" read from "Colofs" with long s. The line-final word "honę-" is hard to read; the last letters are uncertain. The printed text at the foot of the page is only the signature "Ee 4"; no marginal notes or catchword are visible. Small stray marks in both margins and above "menfam" and "recedere" are not printed text and were left out.
